description: Makes a print-ready PDF water report for a Texas address or coordinate: aquifers under the site and the groundwater district, the formations around it ranked by grade, the nearest graded water areas, a proposed supply well (depth, screen, expected yield, water quality, water level) drawn beside the analog wells it rests on, the analog well table, water quality by aquifer with sample years, the district's adopted rules with page numbers (exempt wells, permits, spacing, per-acre caps, export, fees, metering), a demand and water-rights check, and the method. Returns a link that opens the PDF and expires after 30 minutes. Use when someone wants a water report or a write-up of the water at their site. Enterprise.

acres.description: Contiguous acres owned or leased for groundwater rights (optional).

address.description: Texas street address, e.g. '1201 Main St, Houston, TX'. Use this or lat/lng.

demand_gpm.description: Water demand in gallons per minute (optional).

demand_mgd.description: Water demand in million gallons per day (optional).

lat.description: Latitude (WGS84). Use with lng instead of address.

lng.description: Longitude (WGS84). Use with lat instead of address.

radius_mi.description: Analog search radius in miles. Default 5, max 15.

name: water_report
title: Water site report (PDF)
